restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: They asked me if I’m having financial difficulties because my skin is white. 🤣🤣🤣 I’m in disbelief. …

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text:
I went to see a psychiatrist to heal my mind,
but I left feeling even worse 🥲🥲🥲
My emotional control and communication skills are not appropriate for this type of patient.
I should start taking care of myself first before treating others.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: I wanted to give 0 stars, but there's no option for that here. The doctor's words were terrible. I cry every time I think about what was said. Even months later, I still feel terrible and cry, my heart races every time I think about it. Doctors should have better professionalism and conduct themselves appropriately with patients. As a psychiatrist, you should understand your patients and communicate more effectively. After reading the reviews, it's no surprise there are so many 1-star ratings. I feel sorry for the patients who go to see this doctor without knowing their true character. I've never experienced anything like this with other doctors. They were understanding, listened, asked about everything in my life, made me feel less stressed, and were encouraging. I always smiled when I talked to them. But with this doctor, I walked out crying. It was a waste of time and mental health. I endured treatment for so long, but it's better to leave. I wish I had read the reviews beforehand.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: After reading the reviews, I understand why people gave it 1 star. The counter staff were very rude. I initially thought they would have read the reviews and improved on the staff's poor customer service. But I experienced the same thing as many other comments. I really hope they improve their staff. 😔 …

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text:
Not recommended for those requiring gentle mental health care. The doctor's behavior and communication made the experience worse than before treatment. I brought my father to see a psychiatrist, but instead received emotionally charged and inappropriate language, including directed at the patient's relatives. This happened every single time, to the point of being unbearable. This is the first doctor I've ever encountered who was so terrible.
Such behavior suggests the doctor is not emotionally prepared to care for mental health patients.
I believe the doctor should review their own mental state and attitude before caring for others.
I strongly do not recommend this doctor, especially for patients needing understanding and emotional security. The doctor should relinquish their license and seek treatment for themselves first. Thank you. Seeking treatment from this doctor will only make a mentally ill person worse.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: Just walking into the clinic, the staff were already rude. I don't know if they were still upset with their husband at home or what, but they took it out on the people who came to see them. It was insane. And the doctor had absolutely no professional ethics. They wouldn't listen to the patient's reasons, even refusing to help. They said saving a dying person is a merit, but this doctor wouldn't do it, wouldn't listen, and wouldn't offer any guidance. I later found out they work at the provincial hospital. Further investigation revealed the doctor is terrible and doesn't even care about patients. I went to the clinic because of a recommendation from the hospital. I thought it would be good, but I was disappointed from the moment I opened the door and saw the staff. But I still tried to keep a positive outlook, thinking the doctor would be better than the person sitting at the counter. In short... I was disappointed with both the staff and the doctor. One visit is more than enough. I can't recommend them positively at all. It's clear they don't do this out of love for their profession, or are doing it for the money... lol. A patient going to see a psychiatrist for mental illness might end up even more mentally unstable! 😆

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text:
On the day I planned to visit for mental health consultation, I encountered an unfriendly receptionist. Her gaze, tone of voice, and demeanor were impolite, and her service was unprofessional. These elements made me feel uncomfortable from the moment I stepped inside.

Ultimately, I decided to leave, believing that effective treatment begins with a feeling of safety and a welcoming environment. If the initial experience was so uncomfortable, I feared the subsequent care would not meet my needs.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: Very bad, starting from the female staff in front of the doctor's office, she looked bad to the patients until the patients had to talk to each other. In the end, I decided not to get treatment. I had to pay a fine of 20 baht for the card. The more I read the reviews, the happier I am that I don't have to waste more money on this place.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: The staff were rude. I asked for advice but didn't get any good advice. It's very stressful when the staff speak like that. I don't want to keep this job. Think carefully before you decide to hire them.
author_name: ศุภมัฑณี ตุลารักษ์

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: The doctor was incredibly rude and kept making things worse for the patient. The treatment was ridiculously expensive; a conversation that lasted less than 10 minutes cost almost 3000 baht. Don't come here; you'll be 100 times more stressed.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: The doctor spoke very rudely. I went to see the doctor hoping for advice that would improve my situation, but the doctor's words and tone of voice made me feel worse.
author_name: สาลิณี หวังผล

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: I once received treatment from this doctor at Krabi Hospital. After talking to the doctor, my mental state was worse than before. The doctor was very rude and had a very sharp tongue. The doctor seemed to have mental health issues; they didn't seem suitable for a psychiatrist. Personally, I recommend the doctor get more rest so they can provide higher quality treatment. Treating patients emotionally is unprofessional and lacks standards.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: I was treated elsewhere and almost got better, then I transferred to this doctor here, and it was terrible. One visit was enough. What the doctor said made the patient feel guilty and worse.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: It was a disaster. I'm even more depressed than before. It was my first time there, and I thought the doctor's communication style was just how they talk to patients. It was terrifying. Personally, I think the doctor's counseling was terrible. They didn't support my ideas, only asked questions that made me feel guilty, and I didn't feel like I was in a safe space. Throughout the conversation, I was worried they would yell at me. Their mood swings are terrible; they should take a break. Don't take it out on patients. They should find time to rest. Maybe the doctor should try grounding themselves sometime. Love you.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: Please, doctor, prioritize treating your clinic staff before treating patients. They speak to customers very rudely.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: What is the government doing? Before treating patients, clinics should treat themselves first!

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: The doctor and nurses are very rude and unfriendly.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: The first time I went, my mental health worsened. I paid the price for my mistake, threw away the medication, and never went again.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอสรินญพร
text: I don't recommend it. Go get treatment somewhere else. Don't waste your money here if you don't want your mental health to worsen.

text: How am I supposed to know which medication I'm allergic to if the name isn't written on the bag? The medication is just in a resealable zip-lock bag like regular medicine, and it's very expensive.
